answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, Proof of Stake combined with a verifiable random function beacon can deter Sybil attacks by tying network influence to capital rather than compute. An attacker seeking to flood the system must acquire massive collateral, much like purchasing structural timber to build an isolated island fortress. Consequently, the economic cost of generating counterfeit identities scales linearly with total stake, making coordinated ballot-stuffing economically prohibitive for malicious actors.
